label: Some necessary concrete being has, at a world lacking the actual contingents, power for w obtaining
paraphrase: Conclusion of Pruss's own direction (analyst formulation): some concrete being exists at w, exists at every world accessible from w (NECESSARY_2 de re), and exists at some accessible world lacking every concrete being contingent at w, where it has a power for w's obtaining. No uniqueness, simplicity, firstness, intellect or God; nothing about the power's exercise.
